1875: About friendship, in simple, letter-like words; the theme song of the anime film Doraemon: Nobita's New Great Adventure into the Underworld – The Seven Magic Users.
1876: A young man thinks of someone important beneath the fireworks at the end of a summer festival; a bittersweet song about the end of summer and of a love that never blossomed.
1877: On his way home, a boy catches the scent of the autumn-blooming fragrant olive, and his heart is stirred by the memory of a past love.
1880: Told from the perspective of a boy who can't get the girl he loves out of his head: afraid she will reject him, he confesses his feelings in a song instead of a bouquet.
1881: It compares life to a puzzle: looking back on youthful dreams, some of them abandoned, it says the missing piece is within ourselves, and hope carries us on.
1882: A love song about a couple who travel and experience the world together through the changing seasons, with unchanging love and trust in their shared future.
1884: A boy straightforwardly pursues the girl he loves: excitement and momentum, uncertainty after the confession, then psyching himself up.
1885: It is addressed to the children who will rewrite the future; the theme song of the series Kamen Rider Saber.
1886: Two outsiders, alienated from their surroundings, spend a night together until dawn, and in love find refuge in a different world.
1887: About the journey of a person chasing their dreams who chooses spiritual richness over material wealth; it is pervaded by a lonely yet passionate determination.
1888: Told from the perspective of parents mourning their child who perished at sea in the war; the theme song of the film Rengō Kantai (Combined Fleet).
1889: A woman discovers the beauty of Kyoto, Osaka, and Kobe on a solitary journey, and her heart fills with excitement; the song for JR West's travel campaign of the same name.
1890: It works through a turbulent period in the singer's life, with the message that life in itself is enough; the theme song of the TV drama Coach.
1891: An encouraging song for those who, even when hurt, fight for what matters to them, drawn from the life of Tamaki, who grew up among horses; the theme song of the TV series The Royal Family.
1892: Tamaki Kouji sings about music (the "you" in the song is music itself, perhaps the band Anzen Chitai), which stood by him in his difficult situation; the closing music of TBS's News23.
1893: According to the singer, some hear it as dark or self-mocking, while others take it as encouragement.
1894: On a Tokyo railway station platform, a young couple say goodbye in the season's last snowfall; a nostalgic, bittersweet song about the end of a youthful love.
1895: The theme song of TBS's program "Roman o tabi suru".
1896: An anti-war song; the closing music of the animated film Mobile Suit Gundam F91.
1897: A song with philosophical lyrics; the second opening theme of the anime Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam.
1898: The opening theme of the anime City Hunter.
